# Benzinga

> > Benzinga delivers actionable trading ideas, real-time market news, and comprehensive financial insights through integrated platforms for active traders and investors.

Benzinga is a financial media and data platform providing real-time stock quotes, market analysis, trading tools, and APIs for institutional and retail investors. The platform combines news, research, and market data across equities, ETFs, and cryptocurrencies.

## Key Topics

- Real-time quotes
- Market data
- Trading platform
- Financial news
- Stock analysis
- ETF tracking
- Cryptocurrency
- Trading tools
- Market movers
- Financial APIs
- Premarket analysis
- Investor platform
- Trading ideas
- Portfolio tracking
- Benzinga Pro

## Core Platforms

- [Benzinga Homepage](https://www.benzinga.com): Actionable trading ideas, real-time news, and financial insight for active traders
- [Benzinga Pro](https://pro.benzinga.com): Premium platform with fast market news, trading tools, and real-time data
- [Benzinga Edge Dashboard](https://www.benzinga.com/edge/dashboard): Portfolio tracking and stock analysis dashboard for monitoring positions and market opportunities

## Market Data & APIs

- [Financial Market Data & APIs](https://www.benzinga.com/apis): Comprehensive financial data APIs for brokerages, fintech companies, and institutional clients

## Real-Time Quotes & Charts

- [SPY - S&P 500 ETF Trust](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/SPY): Real-time SPY ETF quote, charts, news, and analyst ratings
- [QQQ - Nasdaq 100 ETF](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/QQQ): Real-time QQQ ETF quote, charts, news, and analyst insights
- [DIA - Dow Jones ETF](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/DIA): Real-time DIA ETF quote tracking Dow Jones Industrial Average
- [GLD - Gold ETF](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/GLD): Real-time GLD gold ETF quote and commodity market data
- [TLT - Treasury Bond ETF](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/TLT): Real-time TLT Treasury bond ETF quote and fixed-income data
- [BTC/USD - Bitcoin Price](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/BTC-USD): Real-time Bitcoin price quote, charts, and cryptocurrency market data

## Market News & Analysis

- [Premarket Movers & News](https://www.benzinga.com/premarket): Premarket stock movers, news, earnings reports, and market analysis

## Optional

- [Benzinga Advertising](https://advertise.benzinga.com): Advertising platform for financial marketing and sponsored content
- [Contributor Onboarding](https://contributor.benzinga.com/contributor-onboarding): Benzinga contributor login and onboarding for platform access
